0122fc6525e3.en: Looking forward, he paid close attention to the curves of the shadow’s petite body frame. Something about it seemed really familiar, so much so that Harry could almost see its fiery red hair in the shadow and the maidly black headpiece that would typically sit on top of it. “Sora?” His weakly inward call didn’t echo in the bathroom; instead, it felt like it had just traveled into a void, forever lost.
0122fc6525e3.t: Memandang ke hadapan, dia memberi perhatian rapi kepada lekuk tubuh bayang yang kecil molek itu. Sesuatu tentangnya kelihatan sangat biasa, sehinggakan Harry hampir dapat melihat rambut merahnya yang menyala dalam bayang itu dan hiasan kepala hitam pembantu rumah yang biasanya terletak di atasnya. “Sora?” Panggilannya yang lemah dan perlahan tidak bergema dalam bilik mandi; sebaliknya, ia terasa seperti baru sahaja mengembara ke dalam kekosongan, hilang selama-lamanya.

17ac00c04994.en: Vol 2 prologue subchapter 1: a red-haired woman and a dark-haired person sit together in a bath, seen from behind.
17ac00c04994.t: Jilid 2 prolog subbab 1: seorang wanita berambut merah dan seorang yang berambut gelap duduk bersama dalam tab mandi, dilihat dari belakang.

1e14117d42b8.en: Harry now remembered the tension he felt when the contract was laid out in front of him for the first time at the dinner table. Even with Itagiba’s drunken stupor, Harry remembered more vividly how Eiri kept to herself while Neferteri kept observing him the whole time. Her demeanor was subtle, but something about it felt far more threatening than the bulging muscles of Itagiba’s forearm wrapping around Harry’s neck, feeling droplets of spit hit his face as Itagiba drunkenly blurted an outward monologue about the king of Sanbi not being good enough for him. Why did Eiri say all of that if she wasn’t going to help me anyways?
1e14117d42b8.t: Harry kini teringat ketegangan yang dirasainya apabila kontrak itu dibentangkan di hadapannya buat kali pertama di meja makan malam. Walaupun dengan Itagiba yang mabuk, Harry teringat dengan lebih jelas bagaimana Eiri mendiamkan diri sementara Neferteri terus memerhatikannya sepanjang masa. Gayanya halus, tetapi sesuatu tentangnya terasa jauh lebih mengancam daripada otot lengan bawah Itagiba yang membonjol melingkari leher Harry, merasakan titisan air liur mengena mukanya sementara Itagiba dengan mabuk menghamburkan monolog tentang raja Sanbi tidak cukup bagus untuknya. Kenapa Eiri cakap semua tu kalau dia memang tak nak tolong aku pun?

2052b06c97a0.en: With his eyes hurting from the light, he blinked a few times, causing Harry’s attention to snap back from purely carnal desires, allowing him to see an empty face with only a wild grin staring him down. “No no no no no”—like a snap of a finger, the fost lamp flickered intensively as the petite body began morphing between multiple girls’ bodies, with the grin remaining the same. Amidst his arrhythmic heart, his mind brought back something that seemed to have slipped through the cracks: Harry was sleeping when a girly figure pinned him down and injected something into his neck. He could still feel the large needle penetrating deep into him, releasing a cold concoction into his bloodstream that poisoned his mind and body.
2052b06c97a0.t: Dengan matanya sakit kerana cahaya itu, dia berkelip beberapa kali, menyebabkan perhatian Harry tersentak kembali dari keinginan berahi semata-mata, membolehkannya melihat wajah kosong dengan hanya sengihan liar merenungnya. “Tak tak tak tak tak”—seperti petikan jari, lampu fost berkelip dengan kuat sementara tubuh kecil molek itu mula berubah-ubah antara tubuh beberapa gadis, dengan sengihan yang kekal sama. Di tengah-tengah jantungnya yang berdegup tidak menentu, fikirannya membawa kembali sesuatu yang seakan-akan telah terlepas melalui celah-celah: Harry sedang tidur ketika satu susuk keperempuanan menekannya ke bawah dan menyuntik sesuatu ke dalam lehernya. Dia masih dapat merasa jarum besar itu menembusi jauh ke dalamnya, melepaskan ramuan sejuk ke dalam aliran darahnya yang meracuni fikiran dan badannya.

31019b4d234a.en: Remembering a girly figure flipping him belly-up during that savage attack in the middle of his first night at Sanbi Castle, he saw a girl with a vicious grin right before she started to suffocate him with her privates. Maybe she had long hair or short hair. It was impossible to tell based on the amalgamation of feminine-looking bodies that created this humanoid-looking figure both in his corrupted memory and in the bathtub in front of him.
31019b4d234a.t: Teringat satu susuk keperempuanan menelentangkannya semasa serangan ganas itu di tengah malam pertamanya di Istana Sanbi, dia melihat seorang gadis dengan sengihan ganas sejurus sebelum dia mula melemaskannya dengan kemaluannya. Mungkin dia berambut panjang atau berambut pendek. Mustahil untuk ditentukan berdasarkan gabungan tubuh-tubuh berupa perempuan yang mencipta susuk berupa manusia ini baik dalam ingatannya yang rosak mahupun di dalam tab mandi di hadapannya.

31491920a0ca.en: Looking forward, he paid close attention to the curves of the shadow’s petite body frame. Something about it seemed really familiar, so much so that Harry could almost see its fiery red hair in the shadow and the maidly black headpiece that would typically sit on top of it. “Sora?” His weakly inward call didn’t echo in the bathroom; instead, it felt like someone had cast silence on him.
31491920a0ca.t: Memandang ke hadapan, dia memberi perhatian rapi kepada lekuk tubuh bayang yang kecil molek itu. Sesuatu tentangnya kelihatan sangat biasa, sehinggakan Harry hampir dapat melihat rambut merahnya yang menyala dalam bayang itu dan hiasan kepala hitam pembantu rumah yang biasanya terletak di atasnya. “Sora?” Panggilannya yang lemah dan perlahan tidak bergema dalam bilik mandi; sebaliknya, ia terasa seperti seseorang telah menjampi kesunyian ke atasnya.

365ab05785dd.en: Why did Itagiba help me? Harry closed his eyes, seemingly blind to whatever else was in the room. A solid answer did not seem to form in his head. I guess why even Eiri helped me? He could see their faces in his head, both looking friendly, but he couldn’t feel the same energy coming from them. Did Eiri ask me to keep this quiet because she feared Itagiba as the king? But isn’t she the king-maid? A silence grew in his head as he searched for the definition of that strange term. Why does king or maid alone feel normal, but king-maid doesn’t?
365ab05785dd.t: Kenapa Itagiba tolong aku? Harry memejamkan matanya, seakan-akan buta terhadap apa sahaja yang lain dalam bilik itu. Jawapan yang kukuh tidak kelihatan terbentuk di kepalanya. Rasanya kenapa Eiri pun tolong aku? Dia dapat melihat wajah mereka di kepalanya, kedua-duanya kelihatan mesra, tetapi dia tidak dapat merasa tenaga yang sama datang daripada mereka. Eiri minta aku rahsiakan ni sebab dia takut Itagiba sebagai raja ke? Tapi bukan ke dia king-maid? Kesunyian menjelma di kepalanya sementara dia mencari definisi istilah pelik itu. Kenapa raja atau pembantu rumah sendiri-sendiri rasa normal, tapi king-maid tak?

39dddd8c7b80.en: Somehow seeing the kid’s nauseated reaction turning into a laugh with his parents didn’t make Harry laugh alongside them. On the contrary, his eyes grew wetter and wetter instead, seeing himself longing to relive that exact moment. Forcing his mind to focus on the parents, Harry still could not see any of their characteristics as he felt this ominous sensation of loss curling through his insides. Within a blink of an eye, the dog disappeared. Trying to look at where the dog was, he then felt his parents call him by a name other than Harry, but he just couldn’t hear it. Although, it didn’t matter anymore as the parents suddenly disappeared as well, leaving the kid behind alone, except it was no longer a kid but a much fatter version of Harry drowning himself in food and beer.
39dddd8c7b80.t: Entah bagaimana melihat reaksi loya budak itu bertukar menjadi ketawa bersama ibu bapanya tidak membuatkan Harry ketawa bersama mereka. Sebaliknya, matanya menjadi semakin basah, melihat dirinya merindui untuk menghidupkan semula saat itu. Memaksa fikirannya menumpukan perhatian pada ibu bapa itu, Harry masih tidak dapat melihat sebarang ciri mereka sementara dia merasa sensasi kehilangan yang menyeramkan ini berpusar dalam dirinya. Dalam sekelip mata, anjing itu hilang. Cuba memandang tempat anjing itu berada, dia kemudian merasa ibu bapanya memanggilnya dengan nama selain Harry, tetapi dia tidak dapat mendengarnya. Walaupun, ia tidak penting lagi kerana ibu bapa itu tiba-tiba hilang juga, meninggalkan budak itu bersendirian, kecuali ia bukan lagi budak tetapi versi Harry yang jauh lebih gemuk menenggelamkan dirinya dalam makanan dan bir.

3ae1558de967.en: Yeahhhh, but look on the bright side! It’s a one-time thing. Eiri’s voice felt like a warm lullaby. Soon after, memories of the Gandew duel started to roll past his brain, from facing Maiara in the duel intro where she cursed like a sailor towards him, to being embarrassed when Sora smelled him up and down like a security dog sniffing for cocaine at an airport.
3ae1558de967.t: Yalahhh, tapi tengok sisi baiknya! Ia sekali je. Suara Eiri terasa seperti dodoian yang hangat. Tidak lama kemudian, ingatan tentang perlawanan Gandew mula bergolek melalui otaknya, dari berhadapan Maiara dalam pengenalan perlawanan di mana dia menyumpah seperti kelasi kepadanya, hingga ke rasa malu apabila Sora menghidunya atas bawah seperti anjing keselamatan menghidu kokain di lapangan terbang.

3c7afe0ee5c6.en: Without a choice in the matter, Harry now saw a mental picture of an even fatter version of himself holding a knife against his own chest. The memory brought a strong desire to end it all, but he just couldn’t shove the knife through his frightened, racing heart. With shaking hands, he lost his grip, letting the knife clank on the kitchen counter as the misery and emptiness of his memories pierced deep into his soul.
3c7afe0ee5c6.t: Tanpa pilihan dalam hal itu, Harry kini melihat gambaran mental versi dirinya yang lebih gemuk lagi memegang pisau pada dadanya sendiri. Ingatan itu membawa keinginan kuat untuk menamatkan segalanya, tetapi dia tidak dapat menikam pisau itu menembusi jantungnya yang ketakutan dan berdegup kencang. Dengan tangan yang menggeletar, dia hilang pegangan, membiarkan pisau itu berdenting di atas kaunter dapur sementara kesengsaraan dan kekosongan ingatannya menusuk jauh ke dalam jiwanya.

43ce196160fa.en: Just a bit more! C’mon! The muscles on Harry’s neck and upper body began bending to the will, allowing him to peek more into the familiar bathroom he was in—his clenched-up face and gritted teeth looked like he was trying to pass kidney stones rather than trying to stare at boobs. With a sudden sharp turn, Harry’s body caved in and allowed a full view of the girl’s petite body, now scrubbing the air as if nothing had happened. His eyes went straight to her small perky breasts, deliriously calling to be played with. His right hand moved on its own, feeling Sora’s warmth and softness while his index finger and thumb pinched her erect nipples. His left hand was summoned towards his throbbing second brain demanding to be stroked.
43ce196160fa.t: Sikit lagi! Ayuh! Otot-otot di leher dan badan atas Harry mula tunduk kepada kehendaknya, membolehkannya mengintai lebih banyak ke dalam bilik mandi yang biasa tempat dia berada—mukanya yang berkerut dan giginya yang diketap kelihatan seperti dia cuba mengeluarkan batu karang dan bukannya cuba merenung tetek. Dengan pusingan tajam yang tiba-tiba, badan Harry menyerah dan membenarkan pandangan penuh tubuh gadis yang kecil molek itu, kini menggosok udara seolah-olah tiada apa yang berlaku. Matanya terus ke buah dada kecilnya yang tegang, seakan-akan memanggil dengan gila untuk dimainkan. Tangan kanannya bergerak sendiri, merasa kehangatan dan kelembutan Sora sementara jari telunjuk dan ibu jarinya mencubit putingnya yang tegang. Tangan kirinya dipanggil ke arah otak keduanya yang berdenyut menuntut untuk diusap.

444012271c62.en: The stagnantly lukewarm soapy bathwater felt serene when paired with the fost lamp mildly hissing, lighting up the bathroom he was in.
444012271c62.t: Air mandian bersabun yang suam dan bertakung terasa tenang apabila digandingkan dengan lampu fost yang mendesis perlahan, menerangi bilik mandi tempat dia berada.

5e61d14c8543.en: He felt this sensation within him explode as if he was in extreme danger, and he had to do something right that instant—somehow. His heart pounded painfully hard, and his breathing got so brief he felt like his diaphragm was about to snap. The sound of tinnitus ringing in his ear was like that of a flashbang going off.
5e61d14c8543.t: Dia merasa sensasi dalam dirinya ini meletup seolah-olah dia dalam bahaya yang melampau, dan dia perlu melakukan sesuatu pada saat itu juga—entah bagaimana. Jantungnya berdegup kencang hingga menyakitkan, dan nafasnya menjadi begitu pendek sehingga dia rasa diafragmanya hendak putus. Bunyi tinitus berdering di telinganya seperti bunyi bom tangan kilat meletup.

60fc0ed829b5.en: The energetic girly voice that would be a telltale of Sora did not respond to the call; rather, everything in the room remained the exact same.
60fc0ed829b5.t: Suara keperempuanan yang bertenaga yang menjadi tanda Sora tidak menjawab panggilan itu; sebaliknya, segala-galanya dalam bilik kekal sama.

6604fa342822.en: The stagnantly lukewarm soapy bathwater felt serene when paired with the fost lamp mildly hissing, lighting up the bathroom he was in. He felt like he hadn’t moved in an eternity—or not. Plus, a feeling of déjà vu was growing ever-present. As he was lazily glancing towards the open window, the outside felt familiar. A specific time of day, or even which day it was, allured his conscience. Hmmm, the thought of poking his head out of the window came through, but just something about doing so felt foreign—perhaps forbidden? He still seemingly did not having anything that required his attention, so the faint thought disappeared into the vastness of his mind like rain falling in a lake.
6604fa342822.t: Air mandian bersabun yang suam dan bertakung terasa tenang apabila digandingkan dengan lampu fost yang mendesis perlahan, menerangi bilik mandi tempat dia berada. Dia rasa seperti dia tidak bergerak untuk selama-lamanya—atau tidak. Tambahan pula, perasaan déjà vu semakin terasa. Sambil dia malas-malas mengerling ke arah tingkap yang terbuka, suasana di luar terasa biasa. Waktu tertentu dalam sehari, atau malah hari apa, memikat kesedarannya. Hmmm, fikiran untuk menjengukkan kepalanya keluar tingkap terlintas, tetapi sesuatu tentang berbuat demikian terasa asing—mungkin terlarang? Dia nampaknya masih tiada apa-apa yang memerlukan perhatiannya, jadi fikiran samar itu hilang ke dalam keluasan fikirannya seperti hujan jatuh ke dalam tasik.

66ada9755150.en: Harry shook his head to get that thought out, but the exact memory crept back in. Now his mind seemed to focus on how the counter looked cheap and old—maybe it wasn’t even a kitchen countertop, since nothing else came up in that memory. When was I this fat? Clearly, this had to be before I woke up at Sanbi Kingdom, but when? I hope Eiri will find out for me—
66ada9755150.t: Harry menggeleng kepala untuk mengeluarkan fikiran itu, tetapi ingatan yang sama merayap kembali. Kini fikirannya seakan-akan menumpukan perhatian pada betapa kaunter itu kelihatan murah dan lama—mungkin ia bukan pun kaunter dapur, kerana tiada apa lagi yang muncul dalam ingatan itu. Bila aku segemuk ni? Jelas, ni mesti sebelum aku tersedar kat Kerajaan Sanbi, tapi bila? Aku harap Eiri akan cari tahu untuk aku—

673c78320fe1.en: The energetic girly voice that would be a telltale of Sora did not respond, and she kept scrubbing Harry’s back in the same exact spot as if she were a robot.
673c78320fe1.t: Suara keperempuanan yang bertenaga yang menjadi tanda Sora tidak menjawab, dan dia terus menggosok belakang Harry di tempat yang sama tepat seolah-olah dia robot.

7565bcb819ce.en: Maybe it is her! The gentle touch that washed Harry’s upper back, with perfect rhythmical precision and care, somehow kept on hinting that it was her. She’s kinda shy and all. As he kept staring towards the shadow, Harry felt this manly desire surface outwards as his second brain hardened its longing for her. His first brain, meanwhile, was in a stalemate war. One camp filled it with thoughts of turning his head and seeing the true wonders of humanity hidden under her black and blue maidly clothing. The other half seemed impotent, with a mix of fear of hurting her for taking advantage of this situation, all while being scared of an ominous feeling lurking in his chest that could become real if he faced her. As the war in his brain raged on, he slowly filled his lungs to the brim, then let out a long-winded breath that pushed the stale bubbles away in his bathtub.
7565bcb819ce.t: Mungkin memang dia! Sentuhan lembut yang membasuh bahagian atas belakang Harry, dengan ketepatan berirama dan penjagaan yang sempurna, entah bagaimana terus membayangkan bahawa itu dia. Dia memang pemalu sikit. Sambil dia terus merenung ke arah bayang itu, Harry merasa keinginan jantan ini timbul ke luar sementara otak keduanya mengeras kerana merindui Sora. Otak pertamanya, sementara itu, berada dalam perang yang buntu. Satu kem memenuhinya dengan fikiran untuk memalingkan kepalanya dan melihat keajaiban sebenar kemanusiaan yang tersembunyi di bawah pakaian pembantu rumah hitam dan birunya. Separuh lagi kelihatan mati pucuk, dengan campuran ketakutan menyakiti Sora kerana mengambil kesempatan atas situasi ini, sambil takut akan perasaan firasat buruk yang mengintai di dadanya yang boleh menjadi nyata jika dia menghadapnya. Sementara perang dalam otaknya terus bergolak, dia perlahan-lahan memenuhkan paru-parunya hingga penuh, kemudian melepaskan nafas panjang yang menolak buih-buih basi dalam tab mandinya.

833f7b4ecd39.en: When she is about to strike you, raise the Tolerideme shield so that your arm takes the brunt of it, then stab her in the belly with the other hand. Harry could still feel this sort of fatherly moment from Itagiba as he prepared him for the fight by wrapping an odd shield on his arm and giving him a short sword. But then that feeling grew dissonant when he also remembered Itagiba saying, That should make things interesting for everyone.
833f7b4ecd39.t: Bila dia nak pukul kau, angkat perisai Tolerideme supaya lengan kau tanggung bebannya, lepas tu tikam perut dia dengan tangan yang lagi satu. Harry masih dapat merasa saat seperti kebapaan dari Itagiba ini ketika dia menyediakannya untuk pertarungan dengan membalut perisai yang ganjil pada lengannya dan memberinya pedang pendek. Tetapi kemudian perasaan itu menjadi sumbang apabila dia juga teringat Itagiba berkata, Tu patut buat keadaan menarik untuk semua orang.

834517e708d5.en: A sudden mental lock cleared out, bringing with it far more vivid memories, full of details and even stronger feelings—like going from 480i to 8K. Harry slightly smiled, remembering how welcoming Sanbi royalty was after he woke up in the bloodied room that smelled like a wet dog—or, technically speaking, the smell of bagarisa musk. He chuckled inwardly, remembering how once Nina tried to prank him by putting her finger on his belly button then proceeded to profusely gag when she smelled the pungent musk off his dirty belly button for no apparent reason. The same not-so-smart kid dressed in pink was the one to give him his name Harry after making a spectacle of it, ending on a high note by nearly falling to her death.
834517e708d5.t: Kunci mental yang tiba-tiba terbuka, membawa bersamanya ingatan yang jauh lebih jelas, penuh butiran dan perasaan yang lebih kuat—seperti beralih dari 480i ke 8K. Harry tersenyum sedikit, mengingati betapa mesranya keluarga diraja Sanbi selepas dia tersedar di bilik berdarah yang berbau seperti anjing basah—atau, secara teknikal, bau musk bagarisa. Dia ketawa kecil dalam hati, mengingati bagaimana Nina pernah cuba mengusiknya dengan meletakkan jarinya di pusatnya kemudian terus loya teruk apabila dia menghidu musk yang menusuk dari pusatnya yang kotor tanpa sebab yang jelas. Budak yang tidak begitu pandai berpakaian merah jambu yang sama itulah yang memberinya nama Harry selepas membuat pertunjukan tentangnya, berakhir dengan kemuncak apabila hampir jatuh ke maut.

85a89779ba7d.en: That was until he suddenly gasped, waking up back in the bathtub, sitting forward while Sora was still carefully brushing his upper back in the same spot. Harry wanted to look at her, but it felt like he couldn’t—her tantalizing petite naked body was calling out for him, but he just couldn’t bring himself to actually do it. He wanted to know more, but at the same time, he didn’t want her to stop caressing his back. Plus, the warmth of the bathtub was simply too great. Hugging his knees, at least as much he could because of his massive belly, Harry let out a deep breath, looking at the bubbly water slowly waving around, having a rather calming effect.
85a89779ba7d.t: Sehinggalah dia tiba-tiba tercungap, tersedar kembali di dalam tab mandi, duduk ke hadapan sementara Sora masih berhati-hati memberus bahagian atas belakangnya di tempat yang sama. Harry mahu memandangnya, tetapi rasanya dia tidak boleh—tubuh bogel Sora yang kecil molek dan menggoda memanggilnya, tetapi dia tidak dapat memaksa dirinya untuk benar-benar melakukannya. Dia mahu tahu lebih lanjut, tetapi pada masa yang sama, dia tidak mahu Sora berhenti membelai belakangnya. Tambahan pula, kehangatan tab mandi itu terlalu nikmat. Memeluk lututnya, sekurang-kurangnya sebanyak yang dia mampu kerana perutnya yang besar, Harry melepaskan nafas panjang, memandang air berbuih yang beralun perlahan, memberikan kesan yang agak menenangkan.

9ccf054094a6.en: Meanwhile, the fost lamp in the background behind the girly figure began to hiss louder, sounding like a tea kettle boiling. Accompanying that deafening noise was a white light from the same lamp that quickly grew blinding.
9ccf054094a6.t: Sementara itu, lampu fost di latar belakang di belakang susuk keperempuanan itu mula mendesis lebih kuat, kedengaran seperti cerek teh mendidih. Mengiringi bunyi yang memekakkan itu ialah cahaya putih dari lampu yang sama yang cepat menjadi menyilaukan.

a2bd85b9eca5.en: “EIRI! HELP!” Harry clamored out loud in the bathroom, snapping back from his memories, but his voice didn’t seem to reach anyone, not even his own ears. He curled away from whoever that was, seeing that humanoid thing scrubbing the air instead as if nothing had happened. Noticing the fost lamp appearing to be exploding as it shone like the sun, Harry tried to get away, but the white light consumed him—
a2bd85b9eca5.t: “EIRI! TOLONG!” Harry menjerit kuat dalam bilik mandi, tersentak kembali dari ingatannya, tetapi suaranya tidak kelihatan sampai kepada sesiapa, malah telinganya sendiri pun tidak. Dia mengerekot menjauhi entah siapa itu, melihat makhluk berupa manusia itu menggosok udara sebaliknya seolah-olah tiada apa yang berlaku. Perasan lampu fost kelihatan meletup sementara ia bersinar seperti matahari, Harry cuba melarikan diri, tetapi cahaya putih itu menelannya—

a8d0eb0cdade.en: Wait—how did I get here? Wasn’t I fighting Maiara? The latter faction won the stalemate, now asking that question far louder than anything else. Unable to remember anything immediately, Harry’s mind rewound to his earliest memories. Arriving at a cluster of quite jumbled, corrupt memories he had before awakening at Sanbi Kingdom. These memories somehow felt as if they belonged to someone else. Yet, he felt a strong connection to it—kinda like when you see a video of you from twenty years ago, and you know it is yourself in the picture. Still, you’ve changed so much that you’re no longer the same person. In one of the faded memories, a kid that resembled himself was seated between a couple that had to be his parents. He couldn’t tell their faces or anything about their characteristics anymore, but the feeling of calling them Mom and Dad was there. They were together, chowing down tacos and watching TV, while their chubby black-and-white dog was sprawled on the floor near their feet. They seemed simple, yet they were closely connected and happy, even when the dog farted up a storm that smelled like someone was opening a can of expired canned meat and pairing it with heavily aromatic gutter water.
a8d0eb0cdade.t: Kejap—macam mana aku sampai sini? Bukan ke aku tengah lawan Maiara? Puak yang kedua memenangi kebuntuan itu, kini menanyakan soalan itu jauh lebih kuat daripada apa-apa lagi. Tidak dapat mengingati apa-apa dengan serta-merta, fikiran Harry memutar kembali ke ingatan terawalnya. Tiba di sekelompok ingatan yang agak bercampur aduk dan rosak yang dimilikinya sebelum tersedar di Kerajaan Sanbi. Ingatan-ingatan ini entah bagaimana terasa seolah-olah milik orang lain. Namun, dia merasa hubungan yang kuat dengannya—lebih kurang seperti apabila anda melihat video diri anda dari dua puluh tahun lalu, dan anda tahu itu diri anda dalam gambar itu. Namun, anda telah berubah begitu banyak sehingga anda bukan lagi orang yang sama. Dalam salah satu ingatan yang pudar, seorang budak yang menyerupai dirinya duduk di antara pasangan yang pasti ibu bapanya. Dia tidak dapat lagi melihat wajah mereka atau apa-apa tentang ciri-ciri mereka, tetapi perasaan memanggil mereka Mak dan Ayah ada. Mereka bersama-sama, melahap taco dan menonton TV, sementara anjing hitam putih mereka yang gempal terbaring di lantai berhampiran kaki mereka. Mereka kelihatan sederhana, namun mereka rapat dan gembira, walaupun ketika anjing itu kentut bertubi-tubi yang berbau seperti seseorang membuka tin daging tin yang sudah tamat tempoh dan menggandingkannya dengan air longkang yang sangat berbau.

b93497c39858.en: “Will it hurt?” Harry’s own voice echoed in his head as his mind skipped forward to later that night, when he was crying on Eiri’s shoulder, having no idea what to do with the offer he was being given. Oh wait—she did.
b93497c39858.t: “Akan sakit ke?” Suara Harry sendiri bergema di kepalanya sementara fikirannya melangkau ke hadapan ke malam itu, ketika dia menangis di bahu Eiri, tidak tahu apa yang hendak dilakukan dengan tawaran yang diberikan kepadanya. Oh kejap—dia memang tolong.

bee61628b01b.en: Another memory popped into his head of that same odd day. It was when Nina threw a rakuja at him at some point during dinner; he could still taste the tangy, sweet juice from the rakuja as it exploded on his face. The chuckles began to wane when he saw Eiri’s and Maiara’s faces. More memories of them began surfacing, specifically when Eiri gave him a pink promise over the secrets she spilled—or rather, her commentary of what really happened to him. She was so nice to me, but—
bee61628b01b.t: Satu lagi ingatan muncul di kepalanya tentang hari ganjil yang sama itu. Ia ketika Nina membaling rakuja kepadanya pada satu ketika semasa makan malam; dia masih dapat merasa jus masam manis dari rakuja itu ketika ia meletup di mukanya. Ketawa kecil itu mula pudar apabila dia melihat wajah Eiri dan Maiara. Lebih banyak ingatan tentang mereka mula timbul, khususnya ketika Eiri memberinya janji jari kelingking atas rahsia yang diluahkannya—atau lebih tepat, ulasannya tentang apa yang sebenarnya berlaku kepadanya. Dia baik sangat dengan aku, tapi—

c0a3b20260d1.en: The stagnantly lukewarm soapy bathwater felt serene when paired with the fost lamp mildly hissing, lighting up the bathroom he was in. He felt like he hadn’t moved in an eternity—or not. As he was lazily glancing towards the open window, the outside felt familiar. A specific time of day, or even which day it was, allured his conscience. Hmmm, the thought of poking his head out of the window came through, but just something about doing so felt foreign—perhaps forbidden? He seemingly had nothing due today anyways, so the faint thought now slipped out of his mind like a silent fart in the middle of the night.
c0a3b20260d1.t: Air mandian bersabun yang suam dan bertakung terasa tenang apabila digandingkan dengan lampu fost yang mendesis perlahan, menerangi bilik mandi tempat dia berada. Dia rasa seperti dia tidak bergerak untuk selama-lamanya—atau tidak. Sambil dia malas-malas mengerling ke arah tingkap yang terbuka, suasana di luar terasa biasa. Waktu tertentu dalam sehari, atau malah hari apa, memikat kesedarannya. Hmmm, fikiran untuk menjengukkan kepalanya keluar tingkap terlintas, tetapi sesuatu tentang berbuat demikian terasa asing—mungkin terlarang? Dia nampaknya tiada apa-apa yang perlu disiapkan hari ini pun, jadi fikiran samar itu kini terlepas dari fikirannya seperti kentut senyap di tengah malam.

c4aecbc12409.en: The memories of fighting Maiara on the Gandew duel, or Forway duel, or whatever it was called, came to mind; the deafening throbbing pain that he felt from the broken bones still felt real as she struck him with all her might. In response to her attack, he could still hear the crowd chanting his name as he sensed this wired-up feeling taking over him, making him rush with a knife towards Maiara on his turn, only to then have everything go black when he saw her roundhouse kick come flying towards his neck, unable to even react to how quick everything flew by.
c4aecbc12409.t: Ingatan bertarung dengan Maiara dalam perlawanan Gandew, atau perlawanan Forway, atau apa pun namanya, terlintas di fikiran; sakit berdenyut yang memekakkan yang dirasainya dari tulang-tulang yang patah masih terasa nyata ketika dia memukulnya dengan sekuat tenaga. Sebagai tindak balas kepada serangannya, dia masih dapat mendengar orang ramai melaungkan namanya sementara dia merasa perasaan teruja ini menguasainya, membuatkannya meluru dengan pisau ke arah Maiara pada gilirannya, hanya untuk segala-galanya menjadi gelap apabila dia melihat tendangan pusingnya melayang ke arah lehernya, tidak dapat pun bertindak balas terhadap betapa cepatnya segalanya berlalu.

dfe361a908d3.en: Maybe it is her! The gentle rhythmical, precisional scrub that washed Harry’s upper back somehow kept on hinting at her being there. She’s kinda shy and all. As he kept staring towards the shadow, Harry felt this manly desire surface outwards as his second brain hardened its longing for her, now throbbing with carnal desires. His first brain, meanwhile, was in a stalemate war. One camp filled it with thoughts of turning his head and playing with the true wonders of humanity hidden under her black and blue maidly clothing. The other half seemed impotent, with a mix of fear of hurting her for taking advantage of this situation, all while being scared of an ominous feeling lurking in his chest that would become real if he faced her. As the war in his brain raged on, he slowly filled his lungs to the brim, then let out a long-winded breath that pushed the stale bubbles away in his bathtub.
dfe361a908d3.t: Mungkin memang dia! Gosokan lembut yang berirama dan tepat yang membasuh bahagian atas belakang Harry entah bagaimana terus membayangkan dia berada di situ. Dia memang pemalu sikit. Sambil dia terus merenung ke arah bayang itu, Harry merasa keinginan jantan ini timbul ke luar sementara otak keduanya mengeras kerana merindui Sora, kini berdenyut dengan keinginan berahi. Otak pertamanya, sementara itu, berada dalam perang yang buntu. Satu kem memenuhinya dengan fikiran untuk memalingkan kepalanya dan bermain dengan keajaiban sebenar kemanusiaan yang tersembunyi di bawah pakaian pembantu rumah hitam dan birunya. Separuh lagi kelihatan mati pucuk, dengan campuran ketakutan menyakiti Sora kerana mengambil kesempatan atas situasi ini, sambil takut akan perasaan firasat buruk yang mengintai di dadanya yang akan menjadi nyata jika dia menghadapnya. Sementara perang dalam otaknya terus bergolak, dia perlahan-lahan memenuhkan paru-parunya hingga penuh, kemudian melepaskan nafas panjang yang menolak buih-buih basi dalam tab mandinya.

e616572e26e9.en: The fost lamp flickered, coincidentally calling more of Harry’s attention to Sora’s shadow. His mind formed imagery of him grasping and sucking on her tantalizing perky breasts as his hands slid down her body, inviting themselves to her playground. His second brain throbbed firmly at the thought of feeling her warmth. His heart began pounding with an eagerness never seen before while his mind focused on a single purpose of furthering his genes. Harry tried to move his body, but it didn’t obey him at first, so he kept trying. With each attempt, the light coming from the fost lamp seemed to respond with a flicker of its own; the more mental fortitude Harry placed on seeing what had to be Sora’s naked body, the more reactive the light became.
e616572e26e9.t: Lampu fost berkelip, secara kebetulan menarik lebih banyak perhatian Harry kepada bayang Sora. Fikirannya membentuk gambaran dirinya meramas dan menghisap buah dada Sora yang tegang dan menggoda sementara tangannya menggelongsor ke bawah badannya, menjemput diri ke taman permainannya. Otak keduanya berdenyut kuat memikirkan merasa kehangatannya. Jantungnya mula berdegup dengan keghairahan yang tidak pernah dilihat sebelum ini sementara fikirannya menumpukan pada satu tujuan untuk meneruskan gennya. Harry cuba menggerakkan badannya, tetapi ia tidak mematuhinya pada mulanya, jadi dia terus mencuba. Dengan setiap cubaan, cahaya dari lampu fost seakan-akan bertindak balas dengan kelipannya sendiri; semakin banyak ketabahan mental yang Harry letakkan untuk melihat apa yang pasti tubuh bogel Sora, semakin reaktif cahaya itu.

eafe1af1d00b.en: Vol 2 prologue subchapter 2: a red-haired woman stands behind a heavyset dark-haired man in a dim room.
eafe1af1d00b.t: Jilid 2 prolog subbab 2: seorang wanita berambut merah berdiri di belakang seorang lelaki berambut gelap yang gempal dalam bilik yang malap.
